rationale: The run re-ran the Figure 1 employment-persistence regression (1970-90 growth on 1950-70 growth) dropping Arizona, Florida, and Nevada. results/persistence_convergence.json reports emp_persistence_r2_ex_AZ_FL_NV = 0.6101290902950444, and the step-3 stdout in replication_log.json confirms 'ex-AZ/FL/NV R2=0.610 (paper 0.60)'. Compared to the paper value of 0.60, this is a relative error of ~1.7%, well within the 5% match band. The fix_severity.json fixes (FRED throttling and an elasticity-regression alignment bug in a different step) do not touch this persistence regression path, so the produced value faithfully reflects the method.
